Entry.JapaneseText: チェスター・バークライト
Entry.EnglishText: Chester Burklight

Entry.JapaneseText: アミィ・バークライト
Entry.EnglishText: Ami Burklight

Entry.JapaneseText: バークライト家 現在
Entry.EnglishText: Burklight Household (Present Time)

Entry.JapaneseText: ……アミィ、起きてたのか？
Entry.EnglishText: You're still awake, Ami?

Entry.JapaneseText: あ、お兄ちゃん。
Entry.EnglishText: Ah, big brother.

Entry.JapaneseText: うん……もう寝るよ。
Entry.EnglishText: Yeah... I was about to go to bed.

Entry.JapaneseText: まだ作ってたのか？
Entry.EnglishText: Were you still in the middle of prepping?

Entry.JapaneseText: クレスの誕生日は明日だぞ。 間に合うのかよ？
Entry.EnglishText: Cless' birthday is tomorrow, you know. Aren't you cutting it kind of close?

Entry.JapaneseText: 大丈夫だよ。
Entry.EnglishText: Don't worry.

Entry.JapaneseText: ……お兄ちゃん、
Entry.EnglishText: Big brother...

Entry.JapaneseText: 明日、クレスさんと狩りに行くんでしょ？
Entry.EnglishText: You're going hunting with Cless tomorrow, right?

Entry.JapaneseText: 帰って来るまでには完成させるもん。
Entry.EnglishText: I'll make sure the cake is done before you two come back.

Entry.JapaneseText: もう、５年も経ったんだね。
Entry.EnglishText: It's already been five years.

Entry.JapaneseText: あ？
Entry.EnglishText: Huh?

Entry.JapaneseText: あたしとお兄ちゃんがトーティスに来て、 もう５年も経ったんだなーって。
Entry.EnglishText: I was just thinking, It's been 5 years since you and I came to Totus.

Entry.JapaneseText: なんだよ、急に。
Entry.EnglishText: What's with you all of a sudden?

Entry.JapaneseText: 大変だったけど、楽しかったなー、って。
Entry.EnglishText: It was difficult times, but I enjoyed them.

Entry.JapaneseText: ……お兄ちゃんには苦労させられました。
Entry.EnglishText: You sure put me through a lot.

Entry.JapaneseText: おいおい、母さんみたいな口利くなよ。
Entry.EnglishText: Hey, quit soundin' like our mom.

Entry.JapaneseText: ふふ……。
Entry.EnglishText: Hehe...

Entry.JapaneseText: ねえ、お兄ちゃん、あたしたち、 ここで大人になっていくんだよね？
Entry.EnglishText: Hey big brother, we're gonna keep living here right?

Entry.JapaneseText: あたし、ここが大好き。
Entry.EnglishText: I like it here.

Entry.JapaneseText: ユークリッドにはパパとママの思い出が あるけど、この村の方が好き。
Entry.EnglishText: I have fond memories of our parents in Euclid, but I like this village better.

Entry.JapaneseText: あたし、きっとここで結婚して、
Entry.EnglishText: I'm sure I'll get married here,

Entry.JapaneseText: たくさんの子供に囲まれて、
Entry.EnglishText: be surrounded by a bunch of kids,

Entry.JapaneseText: それで、幸せなおばあちゃんになるの。
Entry.EnglishText: and then I'll be one happy grandma.

Entry.JapaneseText: クレスとか？
Entry.EnglishText: Like with Cless?

Entry.JapaneseText: や、やだ……そんなの、わかんないよ。
Entry.EnglishText: N-No... I'm not sure to be honest.

Entry.JapaneseText: あ、でもお兄ちゃんは、きっとずーっと 独身ね。素直さんじゃないから。
Entry.EnglishText: Oh, but I'm sure you'll always stay single. You're not the honest type.

Entry.JapaneseText: バーカ。
Entry.EnglishText: You dummy.

Entry.JapaneseText: 兄ちゃんはな、これでももてるんだぜ。
Entry.EnglishText: I'm still pretty popular with the ladies.

Entry.JapaneseText: えー、嘘ばっかり。
Entry.EnglishText: Sounds like a bunch of lies to me.

Entry.JapaneseText: タマネギが食べられなーいなんて、
Entry.EnglishText: You still can't even handle onions,

Entry.JapaneseText: 子供みたいなこと言ってる人のところにくる お嫁さんなんかいませんよー。
Entry.EnglishText: there's no way someone would look your way with marriage in mind.

Entry.JapaneseText: うるせえ！ お前！ 早く寝ろ！
Entry.EnglishText: Shut up, will you! Go to bed already!

Entry.JapaneseText: やん！
Entry.EnglishText: Eek!

Entry.JapaneseText: はっ、はっ、はっ……。 まったく……。
Entry.EnglishText:
Pant, Pant, Pant...
Geez...

Entry.JapaneseText: ふふ……ねえ、お兄ちゃん、覚えてる？
Entry.EnglishText: Hehe. Hey big brother, do you remember?

Entry.JapaneseText: あたしたちがこの村で暮らし始めた 日のこと。
Entry.EnglishText: The day we started living here.

Entry.JapaneseText: ん？ ああ、憶えてるよ。 春の……あったかい日だったよな。
Entry.EnglishText: Hm? Yeah, I remember. It was a sunny day in the spring.

Entry.JapaneseText: うん……あったかい日だったよ。
Entry.EnglishText: Yep, it sure was.

Entry.JapaneseText: 五年、か……。
Entry.EnglishText: It's been five years huh...
